```{r}
#| setup: label
library(tidyverse)
library(nycflights13)
```

```{r}
flights
```

```{r}
set.seed(1234)  
res_mean_rnorm_3dig_string <-  
  rnorm(n = 10, mean = 0, sd = 1) %>%
  mean() %>%
  round(digits = 3) %>% 
  # The dot '.' is to show where the content of the pipe should be put
  paste("Result:", .)

res_mean_rnorm_3dig_string
```

```{r}
flights |> 
  filter(
    month == 1, 
    day == 1
    ) |> 
  print(
    n = 5, 
    width = 70
  )
```

```{r}
flights |> 
  filter(
    month == 1, 
    day %in% c(1, 15, 30)
    ) |> 
  tail() |> 
  print(
    n = 5, 
    width = 70
  )
```

```{r}
flights |> 
  filter(
    month == 1, 
    day %in% c(1, 15, 30)
    ) |> 
  View()
```
